proposals.title: STOCKHOLDER PROPOSAL FOR INCLUSION OF DIVERSITY AS A CEO PERFORMANCE MEASURE
proposals.topic_summary: Asks the Compensation Committee to include metrics on gender, racial and ethnic diversity among senior executives as a performance measure for the CEO's incentive plans.
proposals.evidence: our Board unanimously recommends that you vote AGAINST the stockholder proposal

proposals.title: STOCKHOLDER PROPOSAL FOR A REVIEW AND SUMMARY REPORT ON EXECUTIVE COMPENSATION POLICIES
proposals.proponent: Priests of the Sacred Heart, U.S. Province
proposals.topic_summary: Asks for a review of executive compensation policies and a summary report comparing senior executive pay with employees' median wage and assessing pay gap trends.
proposals.evidence: our Board unanimously recommends that you vote AGAINST the stockholder proposal
